variants.name: 现代军用图册
variants.prompt: Use case: ui-mockup. Create one polished high-resolution wide 16:9 desktop RTS game screenshot CONCEPT for ForgeFront / 铸造前线, not a website or presentation. Entire image is game screen, no computer device, no perspective on screen, no oversized marketing title. This is a proposal for an existing top-down real-time province strategy game. Actual playfield has contiguous irregular polygon provinces, not square or hex gameplay tiles. Only infantry, HQ/barracks/workshops/mines and forts; NO tanks, planes, ships, fantasy characters, new gameplay. No fog of war, turn-end, pause, research tree, training queue, inventory, or unit purchase buttons. Gold pays only for building. Troops produced automatically from flowing equipment. Map hierarchy: thin internal province borders, stronger faction boundary, selected barracks double outline distinct from ownership, subtle friendly teal and enemy coral color overlays, neutral sand. A curving thin supply line with white flow dots joins two workshops to the selected barracks; a chunky directional military arrow must look different. Battle on right-center with tiny readable infantry, modest muzzle flashes and one restrained explosion. Noncombat armies are weapon+count tokens, not standing crowds. Terrain details subtle and do not obscure overlays. Coastal landmass, sea left, 12-18 irregular provinces visible, selected barracks left-center, forward battle right-center, neutral land north. All text generous and sparse, accurate Simplified Chinese sans serif. Top status exact: '铸造前线' '黄金 860' '总人数 128' '08:24' '全图' '菜单'. Selected barracks details exact: '兵营' '等级 2' '42 / 60 人' '未装备 18' '已装备 12' '军队 12'. One readable compact supply diagram: MG icon '机枪' + pierce icon '穿透' → infantry silhouette; each input '0.25 件/秒', result '装配中 · 4 秒/人'. Do not show a queue. Sidebar or bottom selected details only, no army action button grid. Small bottom hint '左拖下令 · 右拖平移 · 滚轮缩放'. Include tiny corner caption '概念方案 · 非实机画面'. Use strong information hierarchy, precision aligned spacing, coherent purposeful art, not generic dashboard cards. Variant A: MODERN LIGHT CARTOGRAPHIC ATLAS. Inspired by clarity and sparse chrome of Polytopia, translated into entirely 2D orthographic map, and elegant printed operational maps. Warm ivory UI, deep petroleum text, teal accent, warm ochre selected outline. Sea pale muted azure with subtle shoreline depth bands, flat sage land, sparse stylized overhead tree canopies and rocks, fine topographic contour accents. Military buildings are crisp vector-like top-down geometric silhouettes with a little flat layer depth, not isometric. Premium editorial typography, thin dividers, extremely restrained shadows. Layout: narrow top resource strip around 5% height, main map fills screen, one floating ivory selected barracks inspector in upper right about 22% screen width and 65% height, generous remaining map. No permanent bottom dock. A tiny quiet map legend near lower left. Aim refined believable indie strategy shipping UI, clean and very readable, map is hero. Tiny label 'A / 军用图册'.
